prompt: A cork noticeboard, completely bare, no pins and no pin holes. Painted illustration of ONE object, filling the frame, seen head-on, lit by a single warm lamp INSIDE the scene: real volume, soft shading, believable materials, restrained contours — not a flat two-tone texture, not a glossy cartoon. WARM above all: amber and honey light on the object, brass, worn wood and cream, deep warm shadow; blue-grey only in the shadow side. Inviting and lived-in. NOBODY present, no people, no hands. Nothing on the floor around it, no clutter, no scattered objects. Late-1980s port city. NO TEXT, no letters, NO SIGNATURE, no artist mark, no initials, no logo, no watermark, no painted frame, no border. The mood is CALM and WAITING — the container is EMPTY, nothing has been taken away, the work has simply not started yet.
